task.description:
Fix 13 TypeScript build errors in web/ that caused `npm run build` (tsc -b && vite build) to fail. The type-check (`tsc --noEmit`) passes but the production build uses stricter settings.

Issues to fix:

1. [BLOCKER] ImportMeta.env not recognized in client.ts:11 and useTasks.ts:29 — add `/// <reference types="vite/client" />` or add "vite/client" to tsconfig include/types.

2. [MINOR] Unused variable 'userIds' in identity.ts:54 — remove the unused declaration.

3. [MAJOR] 'e.actor_id' possibly undefined in AuditLogPage.tsx:34 — add null check or optional chaining.

4. [BLOCKER] Property 'components' missing on HealthStatus in HealthDashboardPage.tsx:36 — check the HealthStatus type definition vs usage; fix type or accessor.

5. [BLOCKER] Property 'revoked_at' missing on ApiToken in TokensPage.tsx:91,92,96 — add `revoked_at` to the ApiToken type or update accessor code.

6. [MAJOR] 'e.instance_id' possibly undefined in DlqPage.tsx:56 — add null check.

7. [BLOCKER] Property 'next_retry_at' missing on DlqEntry in DlqPage.tsx:63 — add to DlqEntry type or fix accessor.

8. [BLOCKER] Property 'items' missing on WebhookSubscription[] in WebhooksPage.tsx:83 — the code treats an array as if it has .items; fix to iterate the array directly.

9. [MAJOR] 'w.event_types' possibly undefined in WebhooksPage.tsx:86 — add null check.

After fixing all errors, verify with: cd web && npm run type-check && npm run build
acceptance_criteria: cd web && npm run type-check exits 0
cd web && npm run build exits 0

result.summary: Fixed all 13 TypeScript build errors across 6 files: added vite-env.d.ts for ImportMeta.env types, removed duplicate ApiToken interface and added revoked_at/next_retry_at/components to types, fixed optional chaining on possibly-undefined accesses in AuditLogPage and DlqPage, fixed unused parameter in identity.ts, and corrected WebhooksPage to iterate array directly instead of accessing .items. Both npm run type-check and npm run build exit 0.
